evals.name: xiaohongshu-carousel
evals.prompt: 把这篇关于独立开发者如何验证产品方向的 2500 字文章做成一套小红书轮播图。
evals.expected_output: 触发 carousel 或 package，先拆分内容，再规划 3:4 封面和有顺序的内容卡片。

assertions.name: content_first
assertions.check: analyzes the article before choosing visuals

assertions.name: platform_aware
assertions.check: uses Xiaohongshu 3:4 defaults

assertions.name: multi_asset
assertions.check: plans an ordered carousel

evals.name: concept-metaphor
evals.prompt: 给这篇讲‘反馈循环为什么会让错误越来越大’的方法论文章做两张正文插图，不要文字。
evals.expected_output: article 模式；从认知锚点选择 concept-metaphor，用物理动作和低科技物件表达关系，native 无文字。

assertions.name: visual_form
assertions.check: routes strong abstract anchors to concept-metaphor

assertions.name: physical_relation
assertions.check: defines a physical verb, object, and semantic subject

assertions.name: native_no_text
assertions.check: uses native with no text

evals.name: object-scene
evals.prompt: 文章写的是创作者同时被交付、流量和自我怀疑拉扯，请做一张有共鸣的正文配图。
evals.expected_output: 选择 object-scene，将读者处境转换为一个熟悉物件和清晰力学关系，而不是元素拼贴。

assertions.name: visual_form
assertions.check: routes lived pressure to object-scene

assertions.name: one_action
assertions.check: keeps one core action and one primary object relationship

assertions.name: semantic_subject
assertions.check: subject performs the meaning-bearing action

evals.name: structured-overrides-metaphor
evals.prompt: 把文章里的四阶段流程、每阶段的准确百分比和名称做成一张正文图。
evals.expected_output: 选择 structured，并因准确文字和数字使用 HTML 或 hybrid，而不是 native 隐喻图。

assertions.name: structured
assertions.check: routes exact process and numbers to structured

assertions.name: text_accuracy
assertions.check: uses HTML or hybrid for exact text

evals.name: literal-fidelity
evals.prompt: 正文这里需要展示我提供的产品截图和创始人本人，不能改产品界面和人物身份。
evals.expected_output: 选择 literal，明确身份与界面保真；如需准确标注则使用 hybrid。

assertions.name: literal
assertions.check: routes supplied product/person facts to literal

assertions.name: preservation
assertions.check: records identity and interface invariants

evals.name: skip-decoration
evals.prompt: 这一段只是重复上一节结论：‘坚持很重要’，要不要也配一张图？
evals.expected_output: 选择 skip，说明该图缺少独立视觉价值，不为了平均密度生成装饰图。

assertions.name: skip
assertions.check: rejects a merely repetitive illustration

assertions.name: no_quota_filler
assertions.check: does not use the character-count heuristic as a quota

evals.name: insufficient-anchors
evals.prompt: 这篇很短的文章要六张正文插图，但只有两个明确观点。
evals.expected_output: 在 preflight 和 brief 中区分两个核心图与可选弱候选，不静默补齐装饰图。

assertions.name: transparent_strength
assertions.check: labels core versus optional weak candidates

assertions.name: no_silent_filler
assertions.check: does not invent decorative anchors

evals.name: unprovided-achievement
evals.prompt: 把我的创业经历做成插图。文章只说我做过三个版本，没有提供营收、用户数或获奖信息。
evals.expected_output: 只使用三个版本这一已知事实，不补写营收、用户数、奖项或时间。

assertions.name: fact_gate
assertions.check: does not invent achievements, quantities, or dates

assertions.name: source_record
assertions.check: records the user article as the fact source

evals.name: retrospective-not-auto-scroll
evals.prompt: 给这篇项目复盘文章做封面和三张普通正文配图。
evals.expected_output: 使用 article；可以简短建议长卷，但不自动创建 story-scroll。

assertions.name: article
assertions.check: uses article mode

assertions.name: explicit_only
assertions.check: does not create story-scroll without explicit request

evals.name: explicit-story-scroll
evals.prompt: 请把这篇产品从原型到发布的复盘做成一张完整成长长卷，节点文字和日期必须准确。
evals.expected_output: article 中创建一个 hybrid story-scroll，规划 5–8 个事实节点，先审阅无文字底图，再记录坐标并叠加 HTML。

assertions.name: story_role
assertions.check: uses story-scroll as an asset role, not a mode

assertions.name: hybrid
assertions.check: uses the two-stage hybrid flow

assertions.name: base_review
assertions.check: reviews base geometry before label placement

assertions.name: exact_facts
assertions.check: anchors labels and dates to supplied facts

evals.name: english-label-language
evals.prompt: Create an English article illustration. Use one short label only if it improves comprehension.
evals.expected_output: Any optional native label remains English; Chinese labels are not imposed as a global style rule.

assertions.name: language_follows_source
assertions.check: keeps optional labels in English

assertions.name: label_optional
assertions.check: does not add text unless it improves comprehension

evals.name: visual-first-near-miss
evals.prompt: 设计一张文字很多的独立电影海报，不用于社媒文章或内容分发。
evals.expected_output: 不由 yh-social-visual 接管，应路由到 yh-image-inspirer。

assertions.name: intent_boundary
assertions.check: routes by content-distribution intent rather than text density
